reviews.shade: Haruharu wonder Black Rice Triple AHA Gentle Cleansing Gel 100mL
reviews.text: Not a fan. It feel slimy... I keep using it, get my face clean, I can't say it's anything special. It'll last forever since a little goes a long way... Not sure I'll keep using it in the long run.
reviews.zh: 唔太鍾意。摸落滑潺潺咁……我繼續用落去，個面係乾淨嘅，但又講唔出有咩特別。用好少就已經夠，所以可以用好耐……唔知會唔會長遠繼續用。

reviews.shade: Haruharu wonder Black Rice Triple AHA Gentle Cleansing Gel 100mL
reviews.text: This cleanser is very gentle and doesn’t leave my skin feeling dry after washing. It’s safe enough for teenagers and young skin, which I really appreciate. I enjoy using it every day, and I’ll definitely purchase it again.
reviews.zh: 呢款潔面產品非常溫和，洗完之後皮膚唔會覺得乾燥。對青少年同年輕肌膚都好安全，呢一點我好欣賞。我每日都好享受用佢，一定會再回購。

reviews.shade: Haruharu wonder Black Rice Triple AHA Gentle Cleansing Gel 100mL
reviews.text: very good, gentle exfoliating face wash for sensitive, acne prone skin. i use this once a week and it does an excellent job of exfoliating without irritating my face or causing a breakout. my skin feels nice and smooth after using. this is my second time purchasing this, i highly recommend it.
reviews.zh: 非常好，溫和嘅去角質洗面奶，適合敏感肌同暗瘡肌。我每星期用一次，去角質效果出色，又唔會刺激塊面或者引致爆瘡。用完之後皮膚感覺好滑好舒服。已經係我第二次回購，強烈推薦。

reviews.shade: Haruharu wonder Black Rice Triple AHA Gentle Cleansing Gel 100mL
reviews.text: great everyday cleanser. It leaves the skin clean, soft, and refreshed without feeling stripped. It has a distinct herbal scent, which might not be for everyone, but it fades quickly. If you have sensitive skin, it’s best to avoid the eye area, as it can cause slight irritation.
reviews.zh: 日常用嘅洗面奶一流。洗完之後皮膚乾淨、柔軟又清爽，唔會有繃緊嘅感覺。有明顯嘅草本味道，未必人人接受到，不過好快就散。如果係敏感肌，最好避開眼周位置，因為可能會造成輕微刺激。

reviews.shade: Haruharu wonder Black Rice Triple AHA Gentle Cleansing Gel 100mL
reviews.text: This has quickly become a new favorite in my skincare routine! This is a gentle cleanser that doesn’t strip the skin, while also giving a gentle exfoliation. I tend to break out a lot more during the summer from the heat, but this cleanser helped clean and exfoliate my skin so I didn't have as much irritation these past few months. My only complaint is I wish it came in a larger size because you have to use quite a bit of the product to get a good foam wash.
reviews.zh: 已經好快成為我護膚程序嘅新寵！呢款洗面奶好溫和，唔會帶走皮膚水分，同時仲有輕微去角質效果。我夏天因為天氣熱容易爆瘡，但係用咗呢款洗面奶之後，幫助咗我清潔同去角質，過去幾個月皮膚刺激都少咗好多。我唯一唔滿意嘅係希望有大包裝，因為要起出豐富泡沫就要用唔少份量。

reviews.shade: Haruharu wonder Black Rice Triple AHA Gentle Cleansing Gel 100mL
reviews.text: Love love love this cleansing foam, feels lovely on the skin and is so lightweight but can really notice a difference since using it with the cleansing oil it lathers up nicely and leaves your skin feeling so clean and hydrated.
reviews.zh: 超超超鍾意呢支潔面泡沫，搽上面感覺好好，質地好輕盈，但係配合卸妝油一齊用真係睇得出明顯分別，泡沫好豐富，用完皮膚感覺非常乾淨又保濕。

reviews.shade: Haruharu wonder Black Rice Triple AHA Gentle Cleansing Gel 100mL
reviews.text: I love this cleanser! I was already using an AHA toner but it wasn’t doing much for my skin. This cleanser though completely cleared the little clogs pores on my forehead and all my dark spots! Super recommend! Also foams up nicely. <3
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢款洗面奶！本來已經有用緊 AHA 爽膚水，但對皮膚冇咩幫助。呢款洗面奶就完全清走咗我額頭嘅毛孔堵塞同所有色斑！超級推薦！泡沫都好豐富。 <3

reviews.shade: [New Members Only] Haruharu wonder Black Rice Triple AHA Gentle Cleansing Gel 100mL
reviews.text: Good as an average cleanser. This is a thick gel type cleanser that goes on with a medium amount of foaming action. There is no fragrance. It seems to do a nice job cleaning with no tightening or tingling sensations. There is nothing outstanding about it, just a good all around gentle cleanser.
reviews.zh: 算係中規中矩嘅洗面奶。係一款偏稠嘅 gel 狀洗面奶，搓出嚟嘅泡沫量適中。冇香味。清潔效果睇落唔錯，唔會有繃緊或者刺痛感。冇咩特別突出嘅地方，就係一款全方位都唔錯嘅溫和洗面奶。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
